brief: Three bases arranged around an empty spot, with a bay tray standing in that spot.

requirements.requirement: Three bases arranged around an empty spot
requirements.evidence: Three full hex bases piece:1,0,0, piece:0,1,0 and piece:-1,1,0 surround the empty cell (0,0,0). The original base at (0,0) was removed to leave that spot empty.

requirements.requirement: A bay tray standing in that empty spot
requirements.evidence: bay:0#0,0#bay4 (Full bay tray, solid, stem hex-bin-bay-s-full-solid) sits at q=0,r=0 level 0, bolted to the three bases. check_build reports meshClash clear and no issues.

finish.summary: Built a bay tray (solid full) standing in an empty cell surrounded by three hex bases at (1,0), (0,1) and (-1,1). Applied the house rules: caps on the open faces and joint bolts locking the bases. check_build is clean with meshClash clear. No props were requested, so none were added.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
